# 1 Load

## 1.1 Libraries of functions: 

I uploaded data and packages of necessary functions to perform the calculations, and set the working directory.

```{r, setup, results=FALSE, include=FALSE, echo = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(warning=FALSE)
package_to_load <- c("readxl", "readr", "dplyr", "ggplot2", "tidyr", "dplyr","RColorBrewer", "car", "gplots")
for (package in package_to_load) {
  require(package, character.only = T); packageVersion(package)
}
extra_to_load <- c("knitr","stringr", "stringi", "ggrepel","ggpubr", "ggbreak","reshape2","ggfortify","cowplot","pheatmap","Seurat","data.table","Matrix")
for (package in extra_to_load) {
  require(package, character.only = T); packageVersion(package)
}
rm(package_to_load, extra_to_load)
```

# 2. SingleCellExperiment

In order to apply the trajectory packages, i need to generate a SingleCellExperiment object:

```{r}
library(SingleCellExperiment)
gex <- df
gex <- gex[,c(2:ncol(gex))]
sce <- SingleCellExperiment(assays = list(counts = gex),
                            colData=metadata)
sce
```

# 4. Cluster-based minimum spanning tree

## 4.1 Basic steps Trajectory analysis:

<http://bioconductor.org/books/3.13/OSCA.advanced/trajectory-analysis.html>

```{r}
library(scater)
by.cluster <- aggregateAcrossCells(sce.nest, ids=colData(sce.nest)[,"Time"])

centroids <- reducedDim(by.cluster, "PCA")

# Set clusters=NULL as we have already aggregated above.
#BiocManager::install("TSCAN")
library(TSCAN)
mst <- createClusterMST(centroids, clusters=NULL)
mst
```

```{r}
line.data <- reportEdges(by.cluster, mst=mst, clusters=NULL, use.dimred="TSNE")
plotTSNE(sce.nest, colour_by="Time") + 
    geom_line(data=line.data, mapping=aes(x=dim1, y=dim2, group=edge))
line.data <- reportEdges(by.cluster, mst=mst, clusters=NULL, use.dimred="UMAP")
plotUMAP(sce.nest, colour_by="Time") + 
    geom_line(data=line.data, mapping=aes(x=dim1, y=dim2, group=edge))
```

```{r}
map.tscan <- mapCellsToEdges(sce.nest, mst=mst, use.dimred="PCA")
tscan.pseudo <- orderCells(map.tscan, mst)
#BiocManager::install("TrajectoryUtils")
library(TrajectoryUtils)
common.pseudo <- averagePseudotime(tscan.pseudo) 
line.data <- reportEdges(by.cluster, mst=mst, clusters=NULL, use.dimred="TSNE")
plotTSNE(sce.nest, colour_by=I(common.pseudo), 
        text_by="Time", text_colour="red") +
    geom_line(data=line.data, mapping=aes(x=dim1, y=dim2, group=edge))

line.data <- reportEdges(by.cluster, mst=mst, clusters=NULL, use.dimred="UMAP")
plotUMAP(sce.nest, colour_by=I(common.pseudo), 
        text_by="Time", text_colour="red") +
    geom_line(data=line.data, mapping=aes(x=dim1, y=dim2, group=edge))
pseudo.all <- quickPseudotime(sce.nest, use.dimred="PCA")
head(pseudo.all$ordering)
```

```{r}
pseudo.og <- quickPseudotime(sce.nest, use.dimred="PCA", outgroup=TRUE)
set.seed(10101)
plot(pseudo.og$mst)
```

```{r}
library(mclust, quietly = TRUE)
cl1 <- Mclust(pca_data$x)$classification
colData(sce.nest)$GMM <- cl1
library(RColorBrewer)
plot(pca_data$x, col = brewer.pal(9,"Set1")[cl1], pch=16, asp = 1)

cl2 <- kmeans(pca_data$x, centers = 4)$cluster
colData(sce.nest)$kmeans <- cl2
plot(pca_data$x, col = brewer.pal(9,"Set1")[cl2], pch=16, asp = 1)

#BiocManager::install("batchelor")
library("batchelor")
pseudo.mnn <- quickPseudotime(sce.nest, use.dimred="PCA", with.mnn=TRUE)
#BiocManager::install("TrajectoryUtils")
library(TrajectoryUtils)
mnn.pseudo <- averagePseudotime(pseudo.mnn$ordering)
plotTSNE(sce.nest, colour_by=I(mnn.pseudo), text_by="Time", text_colour="red") +
    geom_line(data=pseudo.mnn$connected$TSNE, mapping=aes(x=dim1, y=dim2, group=edge))

plotUMAP(sce.nest, colour_by=I(mnn.pseudo), text_by="Time", text_colour="red") +
    geom_line(data=pseudo.mnn$connected$UMAP, mapping=aes(x=dim1, y=dim2, group=edge))
```

## 4.3 Principal curves

```{r}
library(slingshot)
sce.sling <- slingshot(sce.nest, reducedDim='PCA')
head(sce.sling$slingPseudotime_1)
```

```{r}
embedded <- embedCurves(sce.sling, "TSNE")
embedded <- slingCurves(embedded)[[1]] # only 1 path.
embedded <- data.frame(embedded$s[embedded$ord,])

plotTSNE(sce.sling, colour_by="slingPseudotime_1",text_by="Time", text_colour="red") +
    geom_path(data=embedded, aes(x=Dim.1, y=Dim.2), size=1.2)

embedded <- embedCurves(sce.sling, "UMAP")
embedded <- slingCurves(embedded)[[1]] # only 1 path.
embedded <- data.frame(embedded$s[embedded$ord,])
plotUMAP(sce.sling, colour_by="slingPseudotime_1",text_by="Time", text_colour="red") +
    geom_path(data=embedded, aes(x=Dim.1, y=Dim.2), size=1.2)
```

```{r}
sce.sling2 <- slingshot(sce.nest, cluster=colLabels(sce.nest), reducedDim='PCA')
pseudo.paths <- slingPseudotime(sce.sling2)
head(pseudo.paths)
```

```{r}
sce.nest <- runUMAP(sce.nest, dimred="PCA")
reducedDim(sce.sling2, "UMAP") <- reducedDim(sce.nest, "UMAP")

# Taking the rowMeans just gives us a single pseudo-time for all cells. Cells
# in segments that are shared across paths have similar pseudo-time values in 
# all paths anyway, so taking the rowMeans is not particularly controversial.
shared.pseudo <- rowMeans(pseudo.paths, na.rm=TRUE)

# Need to loop over the paths and add each one separately.
gg <- plotUMAP(sce.sling2, colour_by=I(shared.pseudo),text_by="Time", text_colour="red")
embedded <- embedCurves(sce.sling2, "UMAP")
embedded <- slingCurves(embedded)
for (path in embedded) {
    embedded <- data.frame(path$s[path$ord,])
    gg <- gg + geom_path(data=embedded, aes(x=Dim.1, y=Dim.2), size=1.2)
}

gg
```

```{r}
curve.assignments <- slingBranchID(sce.sling2)
table(curve.assignments)
```

```{r}
sce.sling3 <- slingshot(sce.nest, cluster=colLabels(sce.nest), 
    reducedDim='PCA', approx_points=100)
pseudo.paths3 <- slingPseudotime(sce.sling3)
head(pseudo.paths3)
```

```{r}
sce.sling4 <- slingshot(sce.nest, cluster=colLabels(sce.nest), 
    reducedDim='PCA', approx_points=100, omega=TRUE)
pseudo.paths4 <- slingPseudotime(sce.sling4)
head(pseudo.paths4)
```

```{r}
shared.pseudo <- rowMeans(pseudo.paths, na.rm=TRUE)
gg <- plotUMAP(sce.sling4, colour_by=I(shared.pseudo),text_by="Time", text_colour="red")
embedded <- embedCurves(sce.sling4, "UMAP")
embedded <- slingCurves(embedded)
for (path in embedded) {
    embedded <- data.frame(path$s[path$ord,])
    gg <- gg + geom_path(data=embedded, aes(x=Dim.1, y=Dim.2), size=1.2)
}
gg
```

## 5.3 Entrophy based methods:

```{r}
library(TSCAN)
entropy <- perCellEntropy(sce.nest)
ent.data <- data.frame(cluster=colLabels(sce.nest), entropy=entropy)
ggplot(ent.data, aes(x=cluster, y=entropy)) + 
    geom_violin() +
    coord_cartesian(ylim=c(7, NA)) +
    stat_summary(fun=median, geom="point")
```
